we found the sales and quoting very simple and very explanatory.the installation was done in time and very tidy.  our garage where the inverter was installed was left pristine.the after installation service was also exceptional and we were contacted and explained the grid connection, app for monitoring power usage etc.

Their quote came out best $/kWh and their communication was fast and professional. Their quote was conservative about the number of pannels I caould fit, but their install team requoted for a great maximum. They had a scheduled spot come up and were available in under 2 weeks. The team even installed an additional hot water timer and gave some further energy advice. Their support team are still fielding my detailed metering questions. I rate them and have recommended them to neighbours who are following suit.

Thank you. I will certainly recommend your website to friends. The panels are being installed today. I found this all very helpful.

So glad we used Reece and his team for our first system have installed two more since and will be going again shortly with more.
